newsitem.title: USA: Peoples Gas workers ratify contract.
newsitem.headline: Peoples Gas workers ratify contract.

text.p: An agreement between Peoples Natural Gas Co and members of Local 666 of the Service Employees International Union was ratified by union members during a meeting Monday night in Greensburg, Pa., the Consolidated Natural Gas Co subsidiary said Tuesday.
The current contract was due to expire on May 1, the company noted. The union represents 552 Peoples Gas employees.

Peoples Gas' Vice President of Operations Tom Wester said the new two-year contract includes a wage package with a 3-1/4 percent increase during each of the next two years, plus an additional lump sum of $1,000 for signing the contract.
There are no changes regarding active employee medical contributions, Wester said.
